style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the whole and the part are golden satin ribbon bars (the beads and match tiles are honey wood, the same warm gold family): golden keys, a rose-pink Enter as the treat of the same world, butter soft keys, a light panel; never red or violet

images.why: Look: 'A whole bar labelled 100% over a part bar at the same scale' and Stage: 'The whole bar lies at x 110, y 240, 900 long and 70 tall ... the part bar lies under it ... drawn to the same scale'. A bar model, so a satin ribbon (a length at a scale); one skin for the whole bar and the part bar, clipped to the length the tool draws.
images.prompt: A long straight length of pale golden-yellow satin ribbon with fine woven edges and a smooth, soft sheen that glows gently along its length, the same light buttery gold from end to end.

images.why: Screen of phase 1 and Opening: 'the whole bar holds beads of several colours' ... 'a whole bar of 25 beads with 14 red, 8 blue and 3 yellow'. One pale wooden bead drawn once per bead and tinted red, blue or yellow by the tool.
images.prompt: One single round polished wooden bead in a pale honey colour, a smooth glossy ball seen from above, with a small round hole through its middle.

images.why: Phase 4: 'thirty match tiles, twenty-one of them marked won and three turned to show a draw' and Stage: 'the match tiles, each 70 by 70, lie in a row ... and are dragged into a Won row ... and a Not won row'. One flat honey-wood tile drawn once per match, tinted for Won and Not won, its face blank so the word Draw is drawn in code when it is turned over.
images.prompt: One single flat square wooden game tile in warm honey-brown polished wood, with softly rounded corners, a gentle raised edge and a smooth plain face.
